name: mobilic
description: Review app for the Mobilic frontend (ephemeral, per PR).

REACT_APP_API_HOST.description: Overwritten by .scripts/review-app.sh once the sibling back-end review app is up (then the front-end is redeployed since REACT_APP_* is baked at build time). Fallback to the staging API until then.

MAINTENANCE_MODE.description: Set to any non-empty value to serve the maintenance page (HTTP 503) instead of the app. Leave unset/empty to disable. Takes effect after a restart (nginx config is rendered at container boot).

MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE.description: Text displayed on the maintenance page. Falls back to a default message if unset.
